always-human-path.plain: touches a path that always needs a person's sign-off

cannot-assess.plain: verify could not gather the evidence to judge the PR

extension-failed.plain: a verify extension failed to run

human-merge.plain: verify passed; this PR's policy leaves the merge to a person

human-review:api-contract.plain: an API contract change for a person to review

human-review:asks.plain: a change in an area verify asks a person to review

human-review:database.plain: a database migration for a person to review

human-review:infra.plain: an infrastructure change for a person to review

human-review:judge.plain: the verify judge flagged a risk for a person to review

human-review:policy.plain: the repo's merge policy holds this change for a person

human-review:security.plain: a security-sensitive change for a person to review

human-review:size.plain: the change is larger than most merged PRs here

human-review:unproven.plain: some checks have no evidence that they pass

ledger-open.plain: the PR checklist has open items: unmet acceptance criteria, open follow-ups or questions, a do-not-merge marker, or an unreadable section

no-receipt.plain: the latest commit has not had an automated build and review, or changed after its review

no-session.plain: verify found no session behind this PR

partial-build.plain: only part of the ticket was finished, so the PR is held

repair-exhausted.plain: automatic repair gave up on this PR

ticket-needs-person.plain: the ticket is labelled for a person's answer, so verify will not take this PR until it is answered or labelled for build

ticket-not-selected.plain: the ticket falls outside verify's selection, so verify will not take this PR until it matches or the PR is merged by hand

verify-post-failed.plain: verify could not record its verdict on this commit

worktree-diverged.plain: the session worktree is off the PR head and holds work the PR lacks

worktree-unsynced.plain: verify could not move the session worktree to the PR head

unknown.plain: an issue this version of boss does not recognise
unknown.category: an issue this version of boss does not recognise
